title.en: Compounding, the RBI, payment modes, the stock market and staying safe

text.en:
Asha's grandfather opened a fixed deposit for her and said it would grow.
"That is the magic of compounding," he said.

With compound interest, interest is added to the money and the next interest is earned on the larger amount. 100 rupees at 10 percent becomes 110 after a year and 121 after two.
The Reserve Bank of India is the central bank that controls money and banks. Payments can be made by cash, cheque, cards, UPI and net banking.
In the stock market people buy and sell small parts of companies called shares, which can gain or lose value. We must guard our PIN and OTP, avoid sharing details and beware of frauds.
